I2.locator: I2 never returns the same opening twice when it arrives from two sources

J4.S3.c2.locator: J4.S3.c2 delivers at the subscriber's local time, not UTC
J4.S3.c2 keeps the same local time across a daylight-saving change
J4.S3.c2 moves a local time that does not exist on a spring-forward day past the gap
J4.S3.c2 fires once on a fall-back day when the local time occurs twice

J4.S3.c3.locator: J4.S3.c3 rejects a timezone that is not a valid IANA identifier

J4.S3.c5.locator: J4.S3.c5 evaluates weekdays in the subscriber's timezone, not as the UTC day

J4.S3.c6.locator: J4.S3.c6 rejects a schedule with no delivery days

J5.S2.c1.locator: J5.S2.c1 admits an on-site Singapore role that explicitly offers sponsorship
J5.S2.c1 excludes an on-site role outside the requested countries
J5.S2.c1 excludes an employer the subscriber excluded

J5.S2.c2.locator: J5.S2.c2 excludes not-stated sponsorship by default rather than treating it as offered
J5.S2.c2 shows not-stated sponsorship only on opt-in, and labels it unknown
J5.S2.c2 always excludes a role that explicitly does not sponsor, even with the opt-in
J5.S2.c2 excludes an unknown work arrangement when the subscriber restricts arrangement

J5.S2.c3.locator: J5.S2.c3 does not treat remote with no stated region as worldwide
J5.S2.c3 applies a stated remote restriction to the subscriber's countries
J5.S2.c3 admits a remote role only when worldwide is explicitly stated

J5.S3.c1.locator: J5.S3.c1 removes openings already delivered to the subscriber

J5.S3.c2.locator: J5.S3.c2 collapses one opening found through two sources into one candidate, keeping both sources
J5.S3.c2 falls back to a normalised canonical URL when no requisition id is published
J5.S3.c2 prefers verified-open evidence over uncertain when collapsing

J5.S3.c3.locator: J5.S3.c3 keeps a different requisition at an employer the subscriber already applied to, and labels it
J5.S3.c3 treats a different requisition at the same employer as a different opening

J5.S3.c4.locator: J5.S3.c4 labels a reopened role rather than suppressing it

J5.S4.c1.locator: J5.S4.c1 trusts feed evidence for 48 hours
J5.S4.c1 trusts browser evidence for 24 hours
J5.S4.c1 re-checks an uncertain opening every run regardless of age
J5.S4.c1 re-checks an opening that has never been verified

J5.S4.c2.locator: J5.S4.c2 includes only verified-open openings within their freshness window

J5.S5.c5.locator: J5.S5.c5 drops a candidate whose relevance output failed validation and so has no score

J5.S6.c1.locator: J5.S6.c1 returns only the surviving matches and reports a shortfall against the subscriber's target

J5.S6.c2.locator: J5.S6.c2 never pads to reach the target with openings that failed a filter

J6.S2.c2.locator: J6.S2.c2 does not close a listing missing from a partial feed response

J6.S3.c2.locator: J6.S3.c2 keeps one identity when only the update date changes

J6.S3.c3.locator: J6.S3.c3 classifies a listing present in the employer's feed as verified open from feed evidence

J6.S3.c4.locator: J6.S3.c4 classifies a listing absent from a complete feed as confirmed closed

J6.S4.c3.locator: J6.S4.c3 treats a login-gated application form as uncertain, not open
J6.S4.c3 classifies an inspected application form for the matching requisition as verified open from browser evidence
J6.S4.c3 classifies a closure notice for the matching requisition as confirmed closed

J6.S4.c4.locator: J6.S4.c4 does not classify an Apply button alone as verified open

J6.S4.c7.locator: J6.S4.c7 never classifies %s as confirmed closed

J6.S4.c10.locator: J6.S4.c10 does not trust a page whose requisition does not match, such as a redirect to another role

J7.S2.c1.locator: J7.S2.c1 derives different keys for different scheduled days and different subscribers

J7.S2.c2.locator: J7.S2.c2 derives the same key for a retry or late send of the same scheduled day
